msg: The shape of the hat did not seem to have importance.The colours on the other hand, make an impact.More intense and vivid colours, such as red, purple, etc appeared through most of the game to bring the biggest yeld.when you start to see that these colours are dipping in terms of mushrooms given, switch to the more neutral colors (brownish). Basically, when one characteristic loses performance (colour intensity), switch to the less vivid colours.
